master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Create Level09, stone bridges, as a premium hand-painted 2D side-scrolling game scene. IMAGE1 is AUTHORITATIVE GEOMETRY. IMAGE2 is STYLE ONLY. Wide 2048x768, 8:3. Trace all green fixed terrain and all FIVE beige bridge slabs in image1. Preserve the upper sky padding and bottom alignment. Precise widths, relative elevations and gaps matter more than composition changes.
FOUR disconnected green terrain groups: left bank with one raised right step; a very small isolated low island near 36% width; middle bank with high left step descending to a low right portion; right exit bank with raised right step. Keep small low island even though spikes are drawn on it; remove spikes only. All deep pits stay open down to bottom, no floor. FIVE separate fixed beige slabs all at same elevation: TWO adjacent slabs above the first large gap, with a very narrow visible gap BETWEEN them (do not merge them); ONE slab just left of the high middle bank; TWO more slabs over the final gap, with a small but visible opening between them. Do not connect the separated slabs or fill spaces with roots. They may have small angled stone/wood braces underneath, no new columns or walkable tops. Yellow exit outline becomes a modest empty ancient stone arch, no door or magic.
Distinct landscape: deep wooded river gorge with graceful willow branches, pale green forest on far ridges and crumbling bridge piers seen deep in the valley, warm slanting light. Keep distant ruins faint enough that they don't read as gameplay ledges. Strong teal depth and rich emerald moss; detailed weathered stone slabs and rock-cut banks, delicate sunlit grass edge, low ferns/flowers. Match image2's beautiful painted style and clarity, no 3D/isometric/pixel art. A dry narrow waterfall channel can sit on a distant cliff near center, but NO WATER painted into this static plate. No mist sprite/particles/long moving strands. Frame only upper corners with leaves; leave all route surfaces open. No text, grid, arrows, labels, border, UI, characters, hazards/spikes, movable blocks, plates, levers, machinery or gems.
